extra.reason: Columns now match mock: type-icon | ID | Title | Epic | Prio | Status. Added Epic column (raw epic_id), removed Assignee/Deps from Issues List. issue-row.js made column-configurable (options.columns) so Epics view keeps its own 7-column layout unaffected. Type cell switched from text badge to icon-only glyph (new app/utils/type-icon.js). lint/tsc/prettier pass; could not run vitest due to a pre-existing jsdom 27.2.0/parse5 8.0.0 ESM incompatibility unrelated to this change (reproduces on unmodified files too).

Fixed via npm overrides pinning parse5 to ^7.3.0 (parse5@8 dropped CJS require export, breaking jsdom's static require('parse5')). jsdom test project now runs; 63/66 files pass. Filed UI-mbm5 for 3 unrelated pre-existing failures.

Fixed all 3: db.test.js used hardcoded POSIX paths ('/x/my.db') incompatible with Windows path.resolve output - switched to mkdtemp()/path.join(). ws.mutations.test.js compared raw '/tmp/...' string against path.resolve()'d cwd - now resolves the fixture path itself. list.navigation.test.js used stale column indices (nth-child(1)/(4)) from DEFAULT_COLUMNS; list.js actually renders columns: [type,id,title,epic,priority,status] so id button is col 2, status select is col 6 - fixed selectors. Full suite: 66/66 files, 285/285 tests pass.

Fixed: made minmax(200px, 1fr) the baseline grid-template-columns for .board-columns-header and .board-lane__body instead of only inside the 1100px media query, so header and lane grids size identically regardless of card content. Removed now-redundant media override.
